scope: Only N calls to step()/clockUnguarded(), after K warmup cycles; stop at marker retirement. Model checks/statistics retained. Construction, loading, warmup, host address/marker checks and snapshots excluded. process_ns measures the subprocess separately.

input.name: independent_integer
input.source:
loop:
addi x1,x1,1
addi x2,x2,2
addi x3,x3,3
addi x4,x4,4
addi x5,x5,5
addi x6,x6,6
addi x7,x7,7
addi x8,x8,8
addi x30,x30,-1
bne x30,x0,loop

input.name: forwarding_chain
input.source:
loop:

        addi x1,x1,1
        addi x2,x1,3
        add x3,x2,x1
        sub x4,x3,x2
        xor x5,x4,x1
        add x6,x3,x4
        addi x7,x6,7
        xor x8,x7,x6
    
addi x30,x30,-1
bne x30,x0,loop

input.name: branch_flush
input.source:
loop:

        xor x1,x1,x2
        beq x1,x0,even
        addi x3,x3,3
        jal x0,join
        sw x0,0(x10)
    even:
        addi x3,x3,1
        beq x1,x0,join
        sw x0,0(x10)
    join:
        addi x4,x4,1
    
addi x30,x30,-1
bne x30,x0,loop

input.name: load_use
input.source:
loop:

        lw x1,0(x10)
        add x2,x2,x1
        lw x3,4(x10)
        add x4,x4,x3
        lw x5,8(x10)
        add x6,x6,x5
        lw x7,12(x10)
        add x8,x8,x7
    
addi x30,x30,-1
bne x30,x0,loop

input.name: consecutive_memory
input.source:
loop:

        lw x1,0(x10)
        lw x2,4(x10)
        lw x3,8(x10)
        lw x4,12(x10)
        addi x1,x1,1
        addi x2,x2,2
        addi x3,x3,3
        addi x4,x4,4
        sw x1,0(x10)
        sw x2,4(x10)
        sw x3,8(x10)
        sw x4,12(x10)
    
addi x30,x30,-1
bne x30,x0,loop
